Owned constructor assigns the deployer msg.sender to the owner variable.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier executes the require(msg.sender == owner) check.

onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.

msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner check to call transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to be the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership executes require(msg.sender == newOwner).
The newOwner state variable is read in the access control require.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner, completing the handover.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
